title: vitex sumatrana var. urceolata
intro: Vitex sumatrana var. urceolata, commonly known as the "Indian vitex" or "Negi", is a plant species within the Verbenaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to alleviate menstrual disorders, reduce fever, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Vitex sumatrana var. urceolata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
